chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad bin Khalid al-Barqi, from Abu Qutada al-Qummi, who ascribed it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),

he said: We mentioned the matter of adolescence/manhood at his place, and so he said: Do you assume that adolescence/manhood is by grievous sinfulness and immorality?! Manhood and adolescence are only a placed meal, a spent attainer, a good righteous matter and an abstained harm. As for that, it is slyness and grievous sin. Then he said: What is manhood? We said: We do not know. He said: Manhood is, by Allah, that a man places his desk at the end of his house.

key_terms.الْخَوَانُ: Desk or table (symbolizing sustenance and provision)
key_terms.الْفِتْوَةُ: Adolescence or manhood (in this context, referring to the state of being a mature, capable man)

ai.seo_question: What is the true definition of manhood (fitwah) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) corrects the common misconception that 'fitwah' implies reckless sinfulness, redefining it as a state of noble character marked by generosity and social responsibility. He emphasizes that true manhood is demonstrated through the practical provision of sustenance, symbolized by setting out one's meal, thereby linking spiritual maturity with tangible economic and social duties. This definition aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition that views 'muru'ah' (manliness) as a holistic virtue encompassing both moral integrity and social utility.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammed bin Khalid al-Barqi, from Abu Qutada al-Qummi, who ascribed it to Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

We mentioned the matter of adolescence at his place, and so he said: Do you assume that adolescence is by grieve sinfulness and immorality? Manhood and adolescence are only a placed meal, a spent attainer, a good righteous matter and an abstained harm. As for that, it is slyness and grieve sin. Then he said: What is manhood? We said: We do not know. He said: Manhood is, by Allah, that a man places his desk at the end of his house.
